personality_one_liner: An elegant, content-led historical lens blending scholarly trustworthiness with a tactile, warm parchment feel.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical rhythms. Keep padding comfortable, allowing text and history to breathe.

do's: Use heavy glassmorphism for floating UI elements over the live camera (location pill, era scrubber, bottom peek card).
Use gradient scrims over historical background images to guarantee text readability.
Apply subtle blur behind the floating 'Did You Know' toast.
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism on text-heavy article screens (Full History).
Do not blur standard form fields or the timeline background.

screens.name: Camera Home
screens.purpose: A live AR viewport anchoring the user to their present location while allowing time travel via the UI.

states.loading: A full-screen surface with an elegant spinner and text 'Unearthing the history of this spot...'
states.empty: N/A - Camera feed is always present once loaded.
states.error: Full-screen surface Inverse with an error message and a retry button.

screens.layout: Camera view flex: 1. Top safe area: A floating glass pill 'Facing: Street Name'. Bottom area: An era scrubber (segmented control) floating above a bottom card. The bottom card (glass or solid surface) shows the historical snippet for the selected era, a scope tag ('This street'), and source count. Floating Action Buttons (FABs) for 'Search' and 'Add Story' placed appropriately above the card. 'Did You Know?' toast appears dynamically as an overlay when nearby.

screens.name: Full History
screens.purpose: A rich, editorial deep-dive into the timeline of the location.

states.empty: Illustration of old parchment with 'No recorded history for this exact spot. Be the first to add an oral tradition!'
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Rendered as a full-screen sheet or pushed screen. Hero image at the top with a gradient scrim and the street name in Playfair Display. Below: A vertical timeline (nodes connecting eras). Includes a 'Then vs Now' image comparison section. Bottom section: List of sources, a 'Play Narration' FAB, and community 'Did You Know' cards. A clear 'Add a story' CTA at the very bottom.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Find specific streets or localities manually.

states.loading: Spinner in the search results area.
states.empty: Illustration with 'Search any street in India'.

screens.layout: Large search input at the top. Below: a list of recent searches or suggested historical spots with small location icons. Clean, text-focused list.

screens.name: Oral Traditions (Add & Review)
screens.purpose: Community contribution layer for local stories.

states.empty: Illustration of a pen/paper: 'No pending stories here.'

screens.layout: Tabs for 'Submit' and 'Community Review'. Submit: Clean single-column form (Name, Title, Story multiline input) with a sticky Submit button at the bottom. Review: A list of pending stories as cards with 'Upvote' counts (x/5).

screens.name: Admin Dashboard

states.empty: Text: 'All caught up! No stories pending review.'

screens.layout: Simple list of pending stories. Each card has the story content and 'Approve' / 'Reject' action buttons.

screens.name: Permissions
screens.purpose: Elegant explainer for Camera and Location access.
screens.layout: Full-screen surface view. Large Playfair Display heading, elegant text explaining the need for permissions to unearth history. Primary CTA to 'Allow Access', secondary to 'Open Settings'.

timeline_hero.alt: Cobblestone street under ancient stone archway

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Editorial Mobile LIGHT' personality. The app should feel like a warm, tactile, high-end magazine or a piece of old parchment.
Do NOT use pure black or stark white. Rely entirely on the provided whitish-brown/cream palette (e.g., surface: #FDFBF7, onSurface: #2A241F, brandPrimary: #5A4634).
For the 'Camera Home' screen, the underlying layer is the live camera. Ensure all overlays (location pill, era scrubber, bottom card) utilize heavy glassmorphism with proper readability layers.
Implement the 'Full History' timeline screen with a clear vertical spine, utilizing Playfair Display for era headings to give an authoritative historical feel.
When displaying text over any background image (e.g., the Full History hero image), MANDATORILY apply a vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to dark) and render text using 'onSurfaceInverse'.
Ensure touch targets for the era scrubber and timeline nodes are at least 44x44pt.
For 'Did You Know' popups, use a floating toast notification overlaid on the camera, appearing seamlessly with a haptic bump.
Never use indigo, blue, or purple. Stick faithfully to the warm earth tones provided.
Ensure the loading screen uses an elegant spinner with the specific text 'Unearthing the history of this spot...' taking up the full screen to set the mood during initial 5-20s load times.
